Read in all spectra and create input matrix for clustering

```{r}
results_dir <- fs::path("..", "ews-nf-out", "cnmf")

# get all the spectra files
spectra_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  path = results_dir, 
  glob = "*.gene_spectra_score.k_*.dt_*.txt", 
  recurse = TRUE
  )

# extract the unique ID for labeling
unique_ids <- stringr::str_extract(spectra_files, pattern = "SCPCL[0-9]+-SCPCS[0-9]+")
names(spectra_files) <- unique_ids 
```

```{r}
# read in all spectra and combine into a single matrix
# rows are genes and each column is a spectra
# any genes that are not present in a spectra will have NA 
spectra_mtx <- purrr::imap(
  spectra_files, \(file, id) {
    
    # extract k value to use for labeling columns
    k_value <- stringr::str_extract(file, pattern = "k_\\d+") |> 
      stringr::str_extract("\\d+") |>
      as.integer() 
    
    k_value <- sprintf("k%02d", k_value)
    
    # read in file and create dataframe
    df <- read.table(file) |>
      t() |>
      as.data.frame() |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id")
    
    # rename columns to have id, k, and nmf number
    nmf_number <- sprintf("%02d", as.integer(colnames(df)[-1]))
    colnames(df)[-1] <- glue::glue("{id}_{k_value}_CNMF{nmf_number}")
    return(df)
    }
  ) |> 
  purrr::reduce(dplyr::full_join, by = "gene_id") |> 
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_id") |> 
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
# use only genes found in both spectra to compute the correlation
cor_matrix <- cor(spectra_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
dist_matrix <- as.dist(1-cor_matrix)
tree <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2")

dend <- as.dendrogram(tree)
dendextend::plot_horiz.dendrogram(dend, leaflab = "none")
```
```{r}
clusters_6 <- cutree(tree, k = 6)
plot(color_branches(dend, k=6),leaflab="none")
```


```{r}
ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  cluster_rows = dend,
  cluster_columns = dend,
  row_split = 6, 
  column_split = 6,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
metaprograms_6 <- split(colnames(spectra_mtx), clusters_6)

na_mp_list <- metaprograms_6 |> 
  purrr::map(\(spectra_list){
    
    mp <- rowMeans(spectra_mtx[,spectra_list], na.rm = TRUE) |>
      # genes with highest score first
      sort(decreasing = FALSE)
    
    # remove any genes with 0 or NA
    # if we do GSEA then we should remove this and keep everything instead? 
    mp <- mp[mp > 0 | !is.na(mp)]
    
  })
names(na_mp_list) <- glue::glue("MP{names(na_mp_list)}")
```


```{r}
na_mp_mtx <- do.call(cbind, na_mp_list)

na_mp_cor_matrix <- cor(na_mp_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  na_mp_cor_matrix
)
```

```{r}
# create a new matrix replacing NAs with 0 
zero_spectra_mtx <- spectra_mtx
zero_spectra_mtx[is.na(zero_spectra_mtx)] <- 0

zero_mp_list <- metaprograms_6 |> 
  purrr::map(\(spectra_list){
    
    mp <- rowMeans(zero_spectra_mtx[,spectra_list]) |>
      # genes with highest score first
      sort(decreasing = FALSE)
    
    # remove any genes with 0 in MP
    mp <- mp[mp > 0]
    
  })
names(zero_mp_list) <- glue::glue("MP{names(zero_mp_list)}")
```


```{r}
zero_mp_mtx <- do.call(cbind, zero_mp_list)
zero_mp_cor_matrix <- cor(zero_mp_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  zero_mp_cor_matrix
)
```

```{r}
clusters_4 <- cutree(tree, k = 4)
plot(color_branches(dend, k=4),leaflab="none")
```


```{r}
metaprograms_4 <- split(colnames(spectra_mtx), clusters_4)
mp4_list <- metaprograms_4 |> 
  purrr::map(\(spectra_list){
    
    mp <- rowMeans(spectra_mtx[,spectra_list], na.rm = TRUE) |>
      # genes with highest score first
      sort(decreasing = FALSE)
    
    # remove any genes with 0 or NA
    # if we do GSEA then we should remove this and keep everything instead? 
    mp <- mp[mp > 0 | !is.na(mp)]
    
  })
names(mp4_list) <- glue::glue("MP{names(mp4_list)}")
```

```{r}
mp4_mtx <- do.call(cbind, mp4_list)

mp4_cor_matrix <- cor(mp4_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mp4_cor_matrix
)
```


Enrichment of high/low lists in MPs 

```{r}
# read in all genesets and create a combined high/low gene list
geneset_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "custom-gene-sets.tsv")
category_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "gene-set-categories.tsv")

category_df <- readr::read_tsv(category_file)
geneset_df <- readr::read_tsv(geneset_file) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(category_df, by = c("geneset" = "geneset_name"))

categories <- category_df$geneset_category |> 
  unique()

ef_genesets <- categories |> 
  purrr::map(\(category){
    
    geneset_df |> 
      dplyr::filter(geneset_category == category) |> 
      tidyr::drop_na() |> 
      dplyr::pull(ensembl_gene_id) |> 
      unique() 
    
  }) |> 
  purrr::set_names(categories)
```

```{r}
# get just the genes for each MP in a list
mp_genelist <- na_mp_list |> 
  purrr::map(\(scores){
    names(scores)
  })

mp_ef_genesets <- c(ef_genesets, mp_genelist)
```

```{r}
UpSetR::upset(UpSetR::fromList(mp_ef_genesets), nsets = length(mp_ef_genesets))
```

```{r}
hs_msigdb_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2")

term_df <- hs_msigdb_df |> 
  dplyr::select(gs_name, ensembl_gene)

universe <- rownames(spectra_mtx)

ora_results <- mp_genelist |> 
  purrr::map(\(genes){
    ora_results <- clusterProfiler::enricher(
      gene = genes,
      universe = universe,
      TERM2GENE = term_df
    )
    
  })

ora_results |> 
  purrr::map(\(results){
    enrichplot::dotplot(results)
  })
```
```{r}
custom_term_df <- geneset_df |> 
  dplyr::select(geneset, ensembl_gene_id) |> 
  tidyr::drop_na()

ora_results <- mp_genelist |> 
  purrr::map(\(genes){
    ora_results <- clusterProfiler::enricher(
      gene = genes,
      universe = universe,
      TERM2GENE = custom_term_df
    )
    
  })

ora_results |> 
  purrr::map(\(results){
    enrichplot::dotplot(results)
  })
```
